customer_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
business_problem: ICBC needed a faster, more elastic cloud architecture for digital banking workloads because its original serverless platform could not keep up with application growth, model release needs, and the bank's broader push toward cloud-native modernization.
solution_summary: ICBC rebuilt its financial-grade cloud platform around Baidu AI Cloud's Tianhe Stack and Function Compute to create a Serverless 2.0 architecture. The bank integrated the new function-computing core with its existing distributed systems and cloud platform, then used it to support BFF aggregation, server-side rendering, static assets, batch processing, database-update jobs, and rapid model publishing. Function Workflow lets teams compose larger batch tasks from individual functions, while Kafka-triggered execution and direct node connections support operational jobs that spike during peak release periods. By wrapping formerly heavyweight services in function-based interfaces, the bank avoided extra load-balancer deployments, improved elasticity, and gave project managers a faster path to put trained models such as investment backtesting into production. The platform is positioned as a supplement to microservices, helping ICBC modernize applications and lift resource efficiency without abandoning its broader distributed architecture.
products_used: Tianhe Stack Cloud-Native Private Cloud Platform

solution_components.name: Tianhe Stack Cloud-Native Private Cloud Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the private-cloud foundation that underpins ICBC's financial-grade serverless architecture.

solution_components.name: Function Compute
solution_components.role: Supplies the core serverless execution engine for application, batch, and model-serving workloads.

solution_components.name: Serverless 2.0 Platform
solution_components.role: Packages the bank's upgraded function-based architecture and connects it to existing distributed systems.

solution_components.name: Function Workflow
solution_components.role: Combines multiple function steps into larger batch-processing flows for jobs such as text verification.

solution_components.name: Kafka Trigger
solution_components.role: Starts function-based jobs from event streams and supports peak production operations such as model publishing and database updates.

data_flow: Business requests from mini programs, H5, and other banking services are routed into function-based BFF, SSR, and static-resource components on the serverless platform. Batch and model-release jobs are triggered through workflows and Kafka events, and the resulting services or outputs are published back into ICBC's distributed banking environment for production use.
business_outcome: ICBC improved elasticity, lowered infrastructure overhead, accelerated application and model delivery, and created a financial-grade cloud-native reference architecture for broader enterprise modernization.
architecture_clues: The platform supports BFF aggregation, server-side rendering, static resources, batch jobs, database updates, and model release on the same serverless base.
ICBC treats serverless as a complement to microservices rather than a full replacement.
Function Workflow and Kafka-triggered execution were used to orchestrate larger banking batch processes.
